title: Automations : change max profile percentage hard limit
symptom: The hard coded maximum 130% profile percentage in automations is not sufficient for high fat/protein meals, causing high BGs late after meals. The user needs to set a higher percentage manually, which is difficult at night.
cause: The hard coded maximum 130% is not sufficient for high fat/protein meals; the user suggests that security should be on duration rather than percentage.
evidence_quote: The hard coded maximum 130% is not sufficient. At least 150% or, even better 180% limit would be much better.
